title: TestingPluginService
responsibility: Run installed testing plugin scripts headlessly with resource admission and owned-process cleanup.

inputs.name: TestingPluginService.run.root
inputs.description: Project root passed to ModuleCatalogService.load and ModuleInstallService.add, and used as the runner process working directory. The service does not normalize or validate this path itself.

inputs.name: TestingPluginService.run.id
inputs.description: String matched against a catalog entry's definition.id to select the plugin. The matching entry must have testing metadata and be installed or the call throws.

inputs.name: TestingPluginService.run.args
inputs.description: Additional strings appended after the configured testing script in the bun run invocation. Arguments beginning with --headed, --debug, --ui, or --config followed by = or end of argument, and arguments beginning with -c, are rejected; no other argument validation is performed here.

inputs.name: TestingPluginService.run.signal
inputs.description: Optional AbortSignal forwarded to resourceWork and runIsolated. Defaults to undefined when omitted.

outputs.name: TestingPluginService.run
outputs.description: Resolves to 0 when runIsolated reports passed; otherwise it returns the exit code, with a missing or zero exit code mapped to 1. The result is only a numeric status and does not include the runner logs.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws Error with joined catalog-gap text when the catalog reports gaps, when no matching installed entry has testing metadata, or when an argument matches the rejected option patterns. Rejections from catalog loading, plugin installation, resource admission, and isolated execution propagate to the caller.
